design.design: 200 seeds (0..199). Per seed: stress = independent Gaussian noise, sd 0.01, years 1960..2024; 8 event years drawn without replacement from 1970..2023; lead test as declared (3-year window, 1000 draws). A seed flags when share_null_ge_observed <= 0.05.
design.report: alpha = flagged seeds / 200, with the count
design.rule: if alpha > 0.05: report it and propose a fix as a separate declared amendment. Do not apply the fix.
design.what: false-flag rate (alpha) of the lead test on pure noise
